brief: A platform to follow live cricket and football: check the score, then tap in and watch the stream. It should feel live, fast and confident, and sit naturally in the app's dark, electric-green interface.
criteria: Success: says both scores and streams without a cliché play button, reads at 16 px, works in one colour, and matches the app's Space Grotesk + green/cyan design language.

concepts.name: Match point
concepts.idea: The X is the 'vs' of every fixture and the × of every scoreline; the ball at its heart is the live game.
rationale: Covers both halves of the product: scores (vs / ×) and streams (the live ball)
The symbol is the last letter of the wordmark, so icon and name are one system
Built at exact 60° with one cut and one ball; four clean arms survive at 16 px
Space Grotesk outlines, electric green #00F59B and cyan #00D2FF from the app itself

recommendation: Match point is final: use the wordmark as the primary logo, the symbol for the app icon and avatars.
